Kimes identifies A.J. Brown as uniquely important against Seattle because Riq Woolen, the Seahawks corner she viewed as having the size/length to best match Brown, is now in Philadelphia; Seattle may need a group coverage approach and enters with an injured secondary. Her Seattle counter-mechanism is the four-man rush: pressure Drake Maye without spending extra coverage resources so the ball cannot consistently reach Brown.
